cases.direction: An inviting opening, with adult warmth and restraint; not a promotional announcer.
Describe an ordinary action with natural sentence grouping and no imposed drama.
Genuine widening curiosity at a beautiful or surprising place; clear articulation.
An unhurried scene with space to breathe, not sleepy or excessively breathy.
Light, dry amusement that lets the writing carry the joke; no canned laughter.
Tentative interpretation or a question without making every clause rise.
Quiet tension and anticipation, not an added horror voice or whispered sound effect.
A brief clear warning, energetic but not clipped, screamed, or louder by default.
Purpose and forward movement without turning narration into a battle announcer.
Serious weight without melodrama, villainous growling, or flatness.
Controlled sadness that preserves intelligibility; no invented sobbing.
Kind, steady reassurance without patronizing the listener.
Intimate, reflective phrasing, not mandatory whispering or seductive delivery.
Warm happiness and release of tension; not constant shouting.
Hope and sadness held together, with a natural settled ending.
A longer factual or instructional sentence with clauses and important contrasts clear.
Ordinary friendly company, away from the stage.
A playful punchline or welcoming stage line, controlled timing and bright confidence.

A vulnerable, plainly spoken admission, without a wink in the voice.
